chunks: You should adhere to the Book of Allāh

because it is the strong rope, a clear light, a benefiting cure, a quenching for thirst, protection for the adherent and deliverance for the attached. It does not curve so as to need straightening and does not deflect so as to be corrected. Frequency of its repetition and its falling on ears does not make it old. Whoever speaks according to it, speaks truth and whoever acts by it is forward (in action).

key_terms.الْحَبْلُ الْمَتِينُ: the strong rope (metaphor for firm connection to God)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and practical benefits of adhering to the Quran according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) presents the Quran as the 'Habl Allah' (Strong Rope), a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis as the tangible link to divine authority and the Ahl al-Bayt. The description of the Quran as 'not worn out by frequent recitation' underscores its infinite depth (Batin and Zahir), while the promise of 'precedence' (Sabqa) for the doer reflects the Shia emphasis on practical adherence leading to spiritual victory. This serves as a foundational argument for the Quran's sufficiency and clarity, countering claims of ambiguity often raised by other schools.
